text:
Marta G: Incoming external engagement from BlackLotus. Scope: purple-team + focused pen-test on key management and auth flows. Window: Tue May 20 09:00–17:00 UTC. Need to finalize which roles we open and confirm auditstream retention during window. @Sanjay R @Jess L please advise on RBAC and KMS proxy settings.

Sanjay R: I can own ephemeral role mapping. Proposal: create assessor role with read-only to logs and Decrypt on KMS but via our kms-proxy with ACL that logs every decrypt. Will need a shortlived IAM statement. Sample policy below. Thoughts?

Jess L: Agree on proxy. Also want to limit token scope — no write perms to secrets manager or SSM. We need telemetry flag enabled so every request gets x-pt-id header for filtering in SIEM.

Marta G: Good. Also need a checklist for evidence packaging and a clear retest verification criteria. Can we require a remediation PR + unit test + a smoke test run before retest slot?

Ryan T: For retest cadence: propose 48hr SLA for triage ack, 7 calendar days for fixes in low/med, 48–72hr for high/critical depending on exploitability. We'll slot retest windows after fixes pass QA. Ops-Bot will create ephemeral creds when we open window.

OpsBot: deploy scheduled.issued role:assessor-20260520 ttl=6h created by @Marta G. Logs forwarded to SIEM index: pentest-session-20260520.

Marta G: Added one more ask — KMS audit delta. Assessor decrypts must emit an audit entry with request_id and key_id. Sanjay, can you post the proxy config snippet?

Sanjay R: config (snippet):
```
{
  "allow_decrypt": ["assessor-role"],
  "audit_fields": ["request_id","key_id","caller_ip","x-pt-id"],
  "require_x_pt": true,
  "max_ttl_minutes": 360
}
```
Also we'll rotate the proxy token hourly during the window.

Jess L: Noted. I'll toggle auditstream retention to 90 days for that SIEM index and mark it immutable for 7 days.

Marta G: Perfect. Next steps: Sanjay to open PR with role & proxy config; Jess to open SIEM retention change ticket; Ryan to publish retest cadence doc + calendar slots. We'll reconvene Fri 14:00 UTC for pre-window dryrun. :thumbsup: 

Sanjay R: PR draft link: https://git.redwood.dev/infra/kms-proxy/pulls/412. Tagging reviewers: @Jess L @Marta G.

Jess L: Acked, adding reviewers and tests to PR.

Marta G: Thanks team. We'll use the dryrun to validate audit logs + proof artifact packaging (sha256 + redaction checklist).
